title: Ceilings by Kind of Loss on a Keyturn Host Protection Plan Claim
content:
The kind of loss the most recent report on the register names decides which of the ceilings published for the Keyturn Host Protection Plan the claim is opened at.

Where the most recent report on the register names glass, the plan's glass ceiling governs. Where the most recent report on the register names tyres and wheels, the plan's tyre and wheel ceiling governs. Where the most recent report on the register names the interior, the plan's interior ceiling governs. Where the most recent report on the register names any other kind of loss, the plan's ceiling for damage to the body and paint of the vehicle governs.

### The ceilings each plan publishes

| Plan | Glass, USD | Tyres and wheels, USD | Interior, USD | Body and paint, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 750 | 600 | 2500 | 12000 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 1000 | 900 | 3500 | 18000 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 1500 | 1200 | 5000 | 26000 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 2000 | 1800 | 7500 | 40000 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 3000 | 2500 | 10000 | 60000 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 4500 | 4000 | 15000 | 90000 |

### Worked readings (hypothetical)

- The most recent report names glass, on a vehicle written on the Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan: the ceiling is 1000.
- The most recent report names tyres and wheels, on the Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan: the ceiling is 2500.
- The most recent report names the interior, on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan: the ceiling is 15000.
- The most recent report names a theft, missing equipment, a mechanical loss or damage to property belonging to someone else: none of the three named kinds, so the ceiling for damage to the body and paint governs, which on the Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan is 40000.

### The record consulted

The kind of loss is the one named on the most recent report standing on the damage report register for this enrolment; where several reports stand, the earlier ones do not govern.
